## v0.1.9 - Match Manager Modularization

**Architecture Refactoring**
- Extracted match_store.py - single source of truth for all 14 shared state dicts (active matches, player states, action queues, FOV cache, lobby chat, class selections, hero selections, etc.)
- Extracted action_queue.py - 6 functions for persistent player action queue operations with auto-target-aware clearing
- Extracted fov_manager.py - FOV cache accessors and dev mode toggles
- Extracted match_payloads.py - WebSocket payload builders (match start, game state, turn update)
- Extracted lobby_config.py - lobby chat, class selection, and match config operations
- Extracted loadout_generator.py - enemy and hero equipment generation with rarity/floor scaling
- Extracted dungeon_manager.py - dungeon lifecycle, WFC generation, room-based enemy spawning, floor progression
- Extracted pvpve_manager.py - PVPVE match flow orchestration with team distribution and spawn zones
- Added ai_exploration.py - room graph construction and per-team discovery tracking foundation

**Internal Improvements**
- Reduced monolithic match_manager.py (3,220 lines) into focused sub-modules
- Backward compatible - all re-exports preserved, zero import changes needed in callers
- Safety backup preserved (match_manager_BACKUP.py, 125 KB)
- 4040 tests passing - zero regressions
